title: Someone sent you a secret
warning: It is deleted right after you view it. This link will not work again.
deleted: Deleted. The link no longer works.
passwordHint: The sender set an additional password.

errors.gone: This link does not exist (any more). It was already opened, has expired or was reported.
errors.missingKey: The link is incomplete (the part after the # is missing). Please use the whole link.
errors.wrongPassword: The password is wrong. The secret is not lost as long as this page stays open.
errors.corrupt: The secret cannot be decrypted. The link is probably damaged.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.goneOpened: This link was already opened. If you did not open it yourself, someone else may have seen the secret.
errors.goneExpired: This link has expired and the secret was deleted. Please ask the sender for a new link.
errors.goneReported: This link was reported and the secret was deleted. Please ask the sender for a new link if needed.
errors.goneRevoked: The sender withdrew this link and deleted the secret. Please ask them for a new link.
